sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total_rows", COUNT(NULLIF("sales_order"."order_no", '')) AS "f_0", COUNT(NULLIF("sales_order"."job_no", '')) AS "f_1", COUNT(NULLIF("sales_order"."customer_name", '')) AS "f_2", COUNT("sales_order"."order_amt") AS "f_3", MIN("sales_order"."order_amt") AS "lo_3", MAX("sales_order"."order_amt") AS "hi_3", COUNT(NULLIF("sales_order"."sign_date", '')) AS "f_4", MIN(NULLIF("sales_order"."sign_date", '')) AS "lo_4", MAX(NULLIF("sales_order"."sign_date", '')) AS "hi_4", COUNT(NULLIF("sales_order"."order_status", '')) AS "f_5" FROM "sales_order"

SELECT CASE WHEN TYPEOF("sales_order"."order_status") IN ('text', 'blob') THEN SUBSTR("sales_order"."order_status", 1, 121) ELSE "sales_order"."order_status" END AS "v", COUNT(*) AS "n", COUNT(*) OVER () AS "k" FROM "sales_order" WHERE ("sales_order"."order_status" IS NOT NULL AND CAST("sales_order"."order_status" AS TEXT) <> '') GROUP BY "sales_order"."order_status" ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "sales_order"."order_status" ASC LIMIT ?

SELECT CASE WHEN TYPEOF("sales_order"."customer_name") IN ('text', 'blob') THEN SUBSTR("sales_order"."customer_name", 1, 121) ELSE "sales_order"."customer_name" END AS "v", COUNT(*) AS "n", COUNT(*) OVER () AS "k" FROM "sales_order" WHERE ("sales_order"."customer_name" IS NOT NULL AND CAST("sales_order"."customer_name" AS TEXT) <> '') GROUP BY "sales_order"."customer_name" ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "sales_order"."customer_name" ASC LIMIT ?

SELECT "sales_order"."order_amt" AS "v", COUNT(*) AS "n", COUNT(*) OVER () AS "k" FROM "sales_order" WHERE "sales_order"."order_amt" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "sales_order"."order_amt" ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "sales_order"."order_amt" ASC LIMIT ?

SELECT CASE WHEN TYPEOF("sales_order"."job_no") IN ('text', 'blob') THEN SUBSTR("sales_order"."job_no", 1, 121) ELSE "sales_order"."job_no" END AS "v", COUNT(*) AS "n", COUNT(*) OVER () AS "k" FROM "sales_order" WHERE ("sales_order"."job_no" IS NOT NULL AND CAST("sales_order"."job_no" AS TEXT) <> '') GROUP BY "sales_order"."job_no" ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "sales_order"."job_no" ASC LIMIT ?

SELECT SUBSTR(CAST("sales_order"."sign_date" AS TEXT), 1, 7) AS "v", COUNT(*) AS "n" FROM "sales_order" WHERE ("sales_order"."sign_date" IS NOT NULL AND CAST("sales_order"."sign_date" AS TEXT) <> '') GROUP BY SUBSTR(CAST("sales_order"."sign_date" AS TEXT), 1, 7) ORDER BY SUBSTR(CAST("sales_order"."sign_date" AS TEXT), 1, 7) ASC LIMIT ?
